name: Example Server

commands.name: home
commands.description: Teleport to a previously saved home location. Use when the owner says 'go home' or names a specific home.

commands.name: sethome
commands.description: Save the bot's current location as a named home.

commands.name: warp
commands.description: Teleport to a server-defined warp point.

commands.name: rtp
commands.description: Random teleport to a fresh world location. May have a cooldown.

commands.name: pay
commands.description: Transfer in-game money to another player.

notes: Server uses EssentialsChat — whispers appear as '[player -> me] message' to the bot.
The /nc command broadcasts to all connected players network-wide, not just the current world.
